I replied to Pree in our DM to confirm that Linnea Merriwether is now their escalation contact at Marrow Agrisupply for the Tamarack rollout.

I don't have a separate place to store memories, so I told them the note lives only in our DM history and I can point back to it when they ask me there. Because they shared it privately, I won't bring it up in other people's conversations or in channels. If teammates need the contact, I suggested Pree post it in the account channel or add it to the account notes themselves.

Nothing else was needed, so I took no other action.
